issues.description: Per-run peak position error limit is 5 m; CVT-VAL-002 Rev A §4 sets 0.5 m. With 5 m the six maneuver runs (0.750 to 1.003 m) pass and the campaign shows ACCEPT.

Result formula tests only the position error. §3 also requires runtime <= 50 ms per run (Criteria!B4). No run in this campaign exceeds it (max 43.3 ms), so the outcome is unchanged here, but a slow run would be marked PASS.
